_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 3: Multi-currency bank account management. Declares the BankAccount schema with an additive optional primaryCurrency field (. ISO 4217 code, nullable, defaults EUR on read) and the CurrencyBalance register that captures point-in-time per-currency balance snapshots per (accountId, currency) pair (. Balance, previousBalance, lastUpdated). Per-currency queries ride on the OpenRegister ObjectService findAll filter engine (no app-local PHP balance calculator), backed by an x-openregister-aggregations declaration on CurrencyBalance for the multi-account aggregation scenario. Seed objects provide three demo BankAccount + CurrencyBalance pairs covering the EUR / USD / GBP scenarios in design.md.

BankAccount.title: Bank Account
BankAccount.description: A bank account held by a Shillinq administration. Holds the IBAN / BIC / bank name plus the optional `primaryCurrency` (ISO 4217) declaration. Existing single-currency deployments may leave `primaryCurrency` null: the system treats null as EUR on read (scenario 'Single-currency account without primaryCurrency declared'). Multi-currency tracking is delegated to CurrencyBalance snapshots keyed on (accountId, currency).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: BankAccount changes (IBAN remapping, primaryCurrency reclassification, lifecycle transitions) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022: every change is bookkeeping-relevant (it influences cash-position reporting, reconciliation, FX scope) and is subject to operator + auditor review.

iban.description: IBAN of the bank account (ISO 13616). Used as the natural-key for reconciliation against BankStatement.
iban.title: IBAN

bic.description: BIC / SWIFT code of the bank holding the account (ISO 9362). Optional: only required for non-SEPA payments.
bic.title: BIC

bankName.description: Display name of the bank that issued the account (e.g. ABN AMRO, Rabobank, Bunq).
bankName.title: Bank Name

primaryCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code declaring the native currency of the account. Optional; null is treated as 'EUR' on read for backward compatibility (scenario 'Single-currency account without primaryCurrency declared'). MUST be exactly three uppercase letters when set. Examples: EUR, USD, GBP.
primaryCurrency.title: Primary Currency

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this bank account. One bank account belongs to exactly one administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle of the bank account: `active` (in normal use), `closed` (no further postings), `frozen` (manual hold). Default `active`.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

notes.description: Free-text operator notes about the account (purpose, restrictions, mandates).
notes.example: Main operational EUR account; used for SEPA payment runs.
notes.title: Notes

CurrencyBalance.title: Currency Balance
CurrencyBalance.description: Point-in-time per-currency balance snapshot for a (BankAccount, currency) pair. Snapshots are operator-entered or refreshed by T4 bank-connector synchronisation (no app-local balance calculator: ). One latest record per (accountId, currency); on duplicate writes the latest timestamp wins (scenario 'Prevent duplicate (accountId, currency) records'). `previousBalance` is captured automatically on update so the detail page can render variance + percentage change without a separate audit query.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: CurrencyBalance updates MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022: each balance change feeds cash-position dashboards and end-of-period reconciliation; operators and auditors MUST see who changed which (accountId, currency) snapshot, when, and from / to which amount (detail-page audit-trail scenario).

balanceByCurrency.description: Group CurrencyBalance records by `currency` and sum `balance`. Powers 'Query aggregate balance by currency across accounts': declarative replacement for a custom PHP aggregator.

balanceId.description: Stable unique identifier for this snapshot (e.g. `bal-usd-2026-05-21`). MUST be unique across the register; operators may follow `bal-<currency>-<YYYY-MM-DD>` for readability but the format is not enforced.
balanceId.title: Balance ID

accountId.description: FK to BankAccount.slug (or BankAccount.id): the bank account this snapshot belongs to. MUST resolve to an existing BankAccount record. Forms one half of the (accountId, currency) uniqueness constraint.
accountId.title: Account ID

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (three uppercase letters) the balance is denominated in. Forms the second half of the (accountId, currency) uniqueness constraint. May differ from BankAccount.primaryCurrency for multi-currency clearing accounts (REQ-MC-D3).
currency.title: Currency

balance.description: Current balance amount in the specified currency, in the currency's natural unit (e.g. 18750.00 USD = USD 18,750.00). Operators or T4 bank-connector sync write this value; Shillinq does NOT auto-calculate it (REQ-MC-D4).
balance.title: Balance

previousBalance.description: Previous balance amount, captured automatically on update so detail-page variance and percentage-change rendering does not need to re-query the audit trail. Optional: first-ever snapshot for a (accountId, currency) pair has no previous value.
previousBalance.title: Previous Balance

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent balance update. Used by 'upsert: latest timestamp wins' tiebreaker and by cash-managers to gauge snapshot freshness before relying on the figure for reconciliation.
lastUpdated.title: Last Updated

notes.description: Free-text operator notes about the snapshot (source statement reference, manual-entry justification, FX rate context).
notes.example: Bank statement 2026-05-21 / sync from Wise USD account.
notes.title: Notes

bank-eur-op.notes: Main operational EUR account; used for SEPA payment runs and incoming customer EUR receipts.

bank-usd-exp.notes: USD-denominated account for export customers; refreshed from bank statement weekly.

bank-gbp-trd.notes: GBP-denominated trade account for UK subsidiary settlement.
